FireSVMDetector.scope: StandardScaler + SVC(probability=True) only -- Otsu segmentation and blob feature extraction are classical CV code, not exported.

HOGSVMDetector.scope: LinearSVC decision function only -- the HOG descriptor and multi-scale sliding-window pyramid are classical CV code, not exported.

MobileNetSSDDetector.scope: Full backbone + SSD heads. Anchor decoding + NMS stay in Python (thermal_algorithms.human_detection.mobilenet_ssd_anchors) -- apply identically to torch and ONNX raw outputs for a fair comparison.

MVSTGCNDetector.scope: Graph-conv body only, at a FIXED representative actor count (max_actors=5, mask-padded exactly as real inference does). Detection + Kalman tracking + homography projection + graph construction (thermal_algorithms.contact_detection.mv_stgcn / multi_view/*) stay in Python -- not neural-net ops.
